description: Dock dictation-pill window. Scopes IPC + the o8:stt-event subscription to the 'dock' label so the always-on /dictation-pill webview can listen and morph (idle ⇄ recording ⇄ polishing ⇄ success). Without a capability whose `remote.urls` matches the bundled-Next origin AND whose `windows` includes 'dock', Tauri injects no __TAURI_INTERNALS__ into this remote-URL webview, so isTauri() is false and listen() never attaches — the dock paints its idle capsule but can never morph. Label-disciplined: events only, NO window-control / updater / process / shell perms (those stay main-only per dock_window.rs).
